title: Cares table suggestions
description: cares-table-suggestions.json, optional: Scryfall tags that mean caring about something and are not in the cares table, each with the facts it cares about. Suggestions are reported, not applied.

tag.description: A Scryfall tag's slug, as in vocabulary.json without its otag: prefix.

fact.description: A fact name, copied exactly from vocabulary.json.

strength.description: 1 a small bonus, 2 clearly better with it, 3 built around it.

reason.description: One line: why the tag means caring about those facts.
